name: Streamarr
description: Stream Usenet content on demand through the Streamarr Core Server. Thin adapter — no download-to-disk.
overview: Surfaces the Streamarr Core Server's Usenet search results inside Jellyfin and makes them playable through Jellyfin's transcoding pipeline.

versions.changelog: Add a Files page with a unified storage overview (disk, segment cache, pre-downloads, NZB cache, ephemeral sessions) alongside cached-release and ephemeral-file management. Add per-scope playback-range tracking that folds front-end watch heartbeats into watched/buffered timeline data, surfaced through a new segmented timeline rail in the Sessions view. Add rotating, revocable admin refresh-token sessions for browser auth instead of long-lived cookies. Harden Jellyfin PlaybackInfo handling against clients that resend a closed LiveStreamId (observed with Swiftfin's rebuilt player), clearing only truly-dead stream ids and defaulting AutoOpenLiveStream when a client expresses no preference. Rework the Sessions page into a dedicated module with grid and table views.

Add season pack support: rank multi-episode and full-season releases correctly, resolve the right episode from a pack, and prefer a next-episode release from a similar pack when pre-downloading ahead. Add mid-stream release switching so a session can move to a better-matched release without dropping playback, with race-safe pre-download coordination and clearer failure reporting. Surface locally available and in-progress releases from Core to the Jellyfin plugin so search results reflect what's already downloading or ready. Consolidate the web dashboard's Ephemeral Files, Streaming History, and Stream Stats pages into a single tabbed Sessions view, and rename the Sessions nav item to Streams.

Add configurable low-priority pre-downloads that finish the current file after a playback grace period and prepare the next TV episode after a watch-progress threshold, with live job status, article maps, cache retention priorities, and disk-space safeguards. Add a bounded, sanitized operator log viewer that correlates Core events with streams and can optionally merge relevant Jellyfin server logs. Add native Jellyfin download support for Streamarr items through the standard permission-aware download endpoint. Harden NZB validation, multi-provider attempt reporting, and stream diagnostics, and improve series artwork compatibility.

Add a PAR2 repair pipeline: when a needed article is definitively gone mid-stream, Core reconstructs the raw source/RAR bytes from the release's PAR2 set and resumes the open stream at the same offset instead of failing, with a Repairs page for live job status and admin control. Add two-phase playback admission (POST /api/v1/playback-sessions) so slow health/materialization/repair prepares no longer hold Jellyfin's global live-stream lock, with an in-player repair-status notification and a direct-resolve fallback for older Core versions. Add a Streaming History page recording completed playback sessions.

Fix ffprobe media-stream parsing to exclude embedded cover-art (Matroska attached-picture) streams from the playable video track list, preventing them from being misidentified as the primary video stream.

Improve ephemeral TV hierarchy materialization and release refresh behavior, harden streaming around encrypted RAR and NZB file handling, and add configuration and coverage for library engagement and media-source projection.

Move recursive TV hierarchy expansion off the search request path into a background HierarchyEnrichmentDispatcher, add an admin-configurable indexer result limit that applies live without a restart, and lower the idle NNTP connection timeout from 300s to 120s to free pooled connections sooner.

Fix resumed and encrypted-RAR playback stalling under sustained reads: preserve active read-ahead streams across small forward seeks, reuse cached yEnc segment ranges instead of re-downloading articles during interpolation probes, and retain the previous ciphertext block for sequential CBC decryption. Add regression coverage and diagnostic tooling for seek amplification and time-to-first-frame investigations.

Gate the 'Streamarr' library behind deliberate engagement: search hits now materialize into a hidden staging area and only join the visible library once you play, favorite, or mark one watched (removing all three demotes it back), so browsing and searching can no longer spam the library — promoted items become a permanent history exempt from the ephemeral TTL and capacity limits. Also fix metadata loading intermittently for one client while another was materializing something else, honor the Core Server's Retry-After hint instead of a fixed backoff when it is briefly at capacity, and widen the season/episode load timeout so a merely-slow (not broken) TMDB response is no longer discarded as empty.

Fix password-protected RAR releases failing to stream: RAR5 AES-256-encrypted volumes (and header-encrypted RAR4 archives) are now decrypted using the password carried in the NZB's metadata instead of always being rejected as unsupported. Add an admin-only download button for a cached release's raw .nzb file. Also fix a packaging bug where the compiled plugin DLL's AssemblyVersion/FileVersion could drift from meta.json's version.

Fix Sonarr/Radarr custom-format profile imports: specification fields are returned as an array of name/value objects, but were read as a map, so custom-format scoring silently produced no matches. Parse fields as a list (case-insensitively by name), and log the endpoint and JSON path when a profile-import response is unreadable without leaking the API key.

Reuse a retained capability on pause/resume and Jellyfin source reopens instead of repeating NZB, health, materialization, and ffprobe work, and deduplicate concurrent resolves of the same release; add an admin-only manual purge for idle ephemeral files that refuses to interrupt active streams; raise per-stream pacing to keep high-bitrate remuxes ahead of realtime; and key retained sessions to the authenticated console user.

Fix the resume and seek playback-latency regression with header-only seek probes, a read pacer, and fairer NNTP connection-pool sharing; bound the ephemeral cache with a configurable budget; surface per-stream time-to-first-frame diagnostics; and harden escalated ffprobe analysis and cached artwork badges.

Import Sonarr/Radarr quality profiles and custom-format scores, rank releases against a portable custom-format subset, brand library artwork with cached Streamarr badges, add a per-stream diagnostics page, and add a Swiftfin playback-compatibility shim.
Cut cold-start playback latency with NNTP connection warmup, startup read-ahead, cached media probes and RAR materialization, release-registration hydration, and escalated ffprobe analysis.
Add streaming history, ephemeral library management, cache-backed playback, operational monitoring, and optional Pushover notifications.
Add resilient article retries and caching, provider speed tests, indexer-only proxying, client-reachable stream URLs, and improved Jellyfin discovery.
Fix Jellyfin movie playback and TV season/episode navigation, with correct remote-item availability and hierarchy metadata.
Restore Jellyfin Web grouped movie and series search compatibility, with safer query constraint handling and bounded plugin diagnostics.
Lazy TV series and season discovery in Jellyfin, hardened release ownership, and TMDB API Read Access Token support.
Semantic TMDB search aliases, canonical metadata and artwork, and release-gated Jellyfin discovery.
M5 thin-slice: playback via IMediaSourceProvider, pinned-work bootstrap, playback event reporting.
